narrative.overview: Learning is not a casual game; it's a rigorous audit of knowledge where progression is strictly calculated. We refuse the standard casual quiz app look in favor of a high-end fintech terminal. The interface relies on stark backgrounds, high-contrast structural armature, strict monospaced data, and definitive verification stamps. It presents learning as a precise, verifiable transaction.
keyCharacteristics: Strict Armature: Visible borders and strict CSS grid lines form the structure.
Audit-level Metrics: Scores and progress are presented as clearance metrics and data points.
Definitive Validation: Passed modules receive heavy, rotated 'VALIDATED' stamps.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Color does real jobs. There are no decorative washes or gradients. Color is reserved entirely for structural definition (outlines) and status indicators (success, error, warning).

rules.name: The Data Reality Rule
rules.body: If it's a number, a status, or an ID, it is set in Monospace. This enforces the feeling of raw, verified data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is expressed through structural outlines, not Z-axis shadows.

dos: Do use dashed borders for lists to reinforce the ledger aesthetic.
Do apply the Validation Stamps only as a definitive result of an action (e.g., passing a quiz).
donts: Don't use mesh gradients, blur filters, or glassmorphism.
Don't use heavily rounded corners (e.g., 16px or full pills) for structural containers.
Don't use shadows to separate content sections; use borders.
